caption: The drawing shows a square section of fabric or wallpaper featuring a botanical pattern with branches, leaves, and flowers. The background is light beige or off-white. The branches are dark brown and form a tangled, overlapping structure. The leaves are predominantly green with brown outlining and shading, varying in size and orientation. The flowers are clustered in groups and individually scattered; they are mainly yellow, with some brown accents and dark centers, and have a daisy-like appearance. The entire botanical motif is densely packed, occupying almost all of the square section, which contrasts against the plain, light background of the overall page. The artist's name, E. A. Smallen, is printed below the drawing towards the right.
title: Textile
